description: Ajeet-configured Gnat mounted on three concrete pillars in the middle of a fountain in Gandhi Bagh, presented c.1987 by Air Marshal M L Sethi (plaque); painted IE-1205, a serial also worn by the Gnat at Air HQ Delhi (Bharat Rakshak lists both). True identity uncertain - the painted marking is recorded. Coordinates approximate. warbirds.in considers the Vayu Bhavan Delhi Gnat the genuine IE-1205; tail left blank here and the painted serial kept as an alias.
